state_machine_contract: The ARM32 pthread object is a single in-guest 32-bit word. Loads and atomics are callbacks into the shared guest address space. Linux futex calls remain raw host callbacks.
entry_contract: ARM32 addresses and values only. Atomics must serialize with interpreter writes to the same guest address space.
wait_wake_contract: The word read is a raw process-shared ARM32 address. The callback does not return a Darwin pointer or Darwin errno.
binding_scope: agr_bionic_sync and agr_futex_host are installed only in the Apple agr_runtime, and every callback reads or writes a guest address.
host_services: Runtime/HostServices/agr_host_services.h exports clock, vm, file, and thread create/join/detach. It has no wait or wake primitive.
